welcome_intro: Mashruucan cilmi-baaristu wuxuu sahaminayaa “{topic}” isagoo adeegsanaya wareysiyo ay fududeyso AI.
welcome_process: Wareysigu waa qoraal wuxuuna u dhacaa si aan isku mar ahayn. Waxaad ku dhammaystiri kartaa xawaarahaaga.
welcome_voluntary: Ka qaybgalkaagu waa ikhtiyaari. Wareystaha AI ma xukumi doono, wax ku bari doono, ku qancin doono, ama qiimeyn doono fikradahaaga. Waxaan rabnaa inaan fahanno waayo-aragnimadaada iyo aragtidaada.
welcome_message: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad tixgelisay ka qaybgalka mashruucan cilmi-baarista.
consent_intro: Waad ku mahadsan tahay inaad tixgelisay ka qaybgalka mashruucan cilmi-baarista.
consent_voluntary: Ka qaybgalkaagu gebi ahaanba waa ikhtiyaari. Waxaad joojin kartaa wareysiga wakhti kasta adigoon la kulmin wax cawaaqib ah.
consent_privacy: Jawaabahaaga waxaa loo isticmaali karaa cilmi-baaris aqooneed. Wax macluumaad shakhsiyeed oo lagu aqoonsan karo lama ururin doono ilaa aad doorato inaad bixiso.
participant_information_description: Haddii aad rabto inaad wareysiga sii wadato mar dambe, kaydi Aqoonsiga Ka-qaybgalaha. Markaad ku soo noqoto boggan, waxaad geli kartaa isla aqoonsigaas si aad u sii waddo wareysigii hore.
save_participant_id_message: Fadlan kaydi aqoonsigan. Waxaad u baahan doontaa haddii aad rabto inaad wareysiga sii wadato mar dambe.
consent_agreement: Markaad gujiso “Waan oggolahay”, waxaad xaqiijinaysaa inaad akhriday oo fahantay macluumaadka kore isla markaana aad oggolaatay ka qaybgalka cilmi-baaristan.
participant_type_required: Fadlan dooro “Waxaan ahay ka-qaybgale cusub” ama “Hore ayaan uga qaybgalay”.
interview_error: Wareysiga lama sii wadi karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
